verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships and documents an official `bt` CLI. It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs (`bt view logs`), sync data (`bt sync pull`) and manage functions, and it is explicitly positioned for use with coding agents. The probe confirms a CLI quickstart page, and the SDK repo shows `npx braintrust eval` usage. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's reliability in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `bt` is the command-line interface for Braintrust. It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
Install the `bt` CLI to set up, instrument, and run Braintrust with your coding agent
pull them locally with `bt sync pull`
